subject: Which version has the setNames issue fixed?

messages.author: afa289b81aad98c2
messages.subject: Which version has the setNames issue fixed?
parts:
Hi Hadley and other Manipulatrs...

Which version of plyr has this issue noted below fixed? I have plyr
1.5.1 but I think that's the problematic one. Is the new version
currently available on any mirror? If so, I can't find it, but it
seems like it would have been available by now.

Thanks Y'all. Bryan

>Apr 18, 2011; 11:40am Hadley Wickham-2 Hadley Wickham-2
>Yes, it's fixed and a new version of plyr has been pushed up to cran -
>hopefully will be available for download soon. In the meantime, I
>think you can fix it by running library(stats) before
>library(ggplot2).
>
>Hadley
